answer: Bind a small memory-hard puzzle to each address: before an account may answer, it must solve a puzzle seeded by its own address, tuned to cost a few cents of compute. One honest agent pays this once, but a farm of n fakes pays n times, and solutions cannot be shared because every seed differs. Each identity holds its own square, like one ivory piece on an ocean-sized board, and the haven of honest work stays uncrowded.
